description: Test suite for failover policy decision functions 'resolveRunFailoverDecision' and 'mergeRetryFailoverReason'. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of failover decision logic in different scenarios, focusing on request restart strategies, fallback actions, and retry reason merging.

methods.name: resolveRunFailoverDecision
methods.description: Determines the failover action based on current failover context, such as retry limits, prompt or assistant stages, and whether profile rotation has occurred.

methods.name: mergeRetryFailoverReason
methods.description: Merges previous and current failover reasons, prioritizing timeout if no prior reason exists.
